mu_name_from: OpenMU Version075 Items/Weapons.cs:113 and mu.db's items row (group 1, index 7) name it the Larkan Axe against Item/Axe08.bmd.
why_this_one: Drop level 46: the Ice Queen (52) is the only Devias monster that reaches it. See docs/devias-drops.md. Also the Hommerd's weapon in MuMain (ZzzCharacter.cpp:14016), beside the Big Round Shield.
stance_from: ZzzCharacter.cpp:356-368: a sword, axe or mace that is TwoHand (width 2) stands PLAYER_STOP_TWO_HAND_SWORD.
two_handed_from: Width 2 in the call; OpenMU's `group < Bows && width == 2` and MuMain's ItemAttribute TwoHand agree.
material_overrides_note: Steel's own 0.2 mirrors the grass; the Devias batch settled on 0.45 (and plate 0.5 on a pole) after the studio caught black heads and flaring shafts on all six. Set before the first look, and judged in the studio.
material_note: The ornate head is the gold pillar with a face on Axes09 (cream highlights 254,254,204 over 119,75,36) and is brass; the silver bit of the blade shares that island and will read warm -- judge it in the studio. The upper strip is dark brown timber (47,25,11 to 96,52,23); the grip is neutral dark grey with white edges, finished plate.
